text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower and I are on the way<n>back to campus
after going out,<n>when...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, Big Brother?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, Big Sister?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I don't want to say goodbye just<n>yet...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I don't want to say goodbye just<n>yet...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Actually, there's something I want to<n>go see with
you!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Her expression is so sincere I can't<n>say no.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We head up to the academy rooftop<n>to wait for the
sun to set.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: There's supposed to be a meteor<n>shower today.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
As soon as I heard about it, I knew I<n>had to watch it
with you.

As soon as I heard about it, I knew I<n>had to watch it
with you.
Thank you for coming.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you for coming.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: There sure are a lot of clouds, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Sure enough, the sky is full of clouds<n>everywhere I
look, forming an opaque<n>wall over most of the sky.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'm a bit worried that she might<n>blame the state of
the sky on herself,<n>but..

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: H-hey, Big Brother?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: H-hey, Big Sister?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Will you wait with me just a bit<n>longer?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Just until the clouds clear up... Until<n>we can see the
sky.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I look at Rice Shower and realize my<n>concern was
unfounded.
choice_data_list: We should each make a wish.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I look at Rice Shower and realize my<n>concern was
unfounded.
choice_data_list: We should each make a wish.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: H-huh? Stronger? W-what do you<n>mean?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Did I say something weird?
choice_data_list: You were able to tell me you wanted to wait.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, y-yeah. A while ago... I probably<n>wouldn't
have been able to say that.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The old me probably would have<n>started crying...
But I'm not like that<n>anymore.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I decided that I wanted to see<n>shooting stars with
you today...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I decided that I wanted to see<n>shooting stars with
you today...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: And I won't give up until that<n>happens.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah! Look! Look at the sky!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah! Look! Look at the sky!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The clouds have already disappeared,<n>revealing a
night sky full of twinkling<n>stars.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Among the inviting flood of gleaming<n>points, a
sudden streak of light<n>plummets down. Then
another, and<n>another.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wooow! There are so many shooting<n>stars!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Definitely!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: This is sure to be an unforgettable<n>night for us.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad you're staying.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad you're staying.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...What are you going to wish for?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...What are you going to wish for?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! For me?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I didn't expect that, but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It's similar to my wish.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
My wish... is for the happiness of<n>everyone who
supports me...
Including yours.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Including yours.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, a glitter catches the corner<n>of my eye.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Look! The sky...
Look! The sky...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Unbeknownst to us, the sky cleared<n>up during our
chat. When we look up,<n>we see an ocean of stars.
And one<n>falls out of the sky, then another... and<n>then
a shower of them.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wooow! There are so many shooting<n>stars!
choice_data_list: We have to make our wishes!

text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower and I both wish upon the<n>rain of falling
stars.
